messages:
marta: Heads-up: planning a prod base-image refresh tonight 01:30 UTC for runtime pools (gpu + std). Primary asks: minimal RBAC for signing, audit forwarding, and a short rollback plan.
devsec: +1. Confirming key approach: per-cluster asymmetric key in KMS (no org-wide single signer) and rotate old keys after cutover?
marta: correct. create cryptoKey per-cluster, restrict sign to signer service account, CI will impersonate that SA to produce cosign sigs/attestations.
carlos: two immediate enforcement items: 1) disallow serviceAccountKey creation for signer SAs; 2) ensure signer SA cannot create other SAs. Use IAM conditions where possible.
devsec: audit pipeline note: send KMS CryptoKeyVersion.* events and IAM policy.set events to secure-audit -> datadog. Also index cosign attestation payloads so we can query image provenance quickly.
infra-bot: checklist created: PREP(create keyring/key, create custom role, bind SA, update CI job), TEST(sign smoke + verify), CUTOVER(canary 3 nodes), POST(expire old key, rotate kubelet tokens).
marta: can someone paste the minimal terraform we should land in infra PR?
carlos: dropping a compact HCL example, replace role with custom role placeholder:
```hcl
resource "google_kms_key_ring" "images" {
  name = "images-${var.env}"
}
resource "google_kms_crypto_key" "signer" {
  name     = "img-signer"
  key_ring = google_kms_key_ring.images.id
}
resource "google_service_account" "signer_sa" {
  account_id = "img-signer-${var.env}"
}
resource "google_project_iam_member" "signer_bind" {
  role   = "projects/${var.project}/roles/ImageSigner" # minimal custom role
  member = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.signer_sa.email}"
}
```
devsec: Custom role should include only: "cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign" (or similar in provider), and storage.objects.get to allow reading blobs for signing. No owner/editor perms.
marta: runtime nodes must not have sign permission; only verify + public-key access. We'll enforce that via node SA policy.
carlos: vuln triage: the current base had a libssl CVE flagged in scanner. we're moving to a newer distro base which should fix it, but compatibility tests may fail. fallback is to pin older libssl + apply seccomp profile & readonly rootfs for the interim. Add that to the rollback plan.
devsec: also ensure cosign attestations are attached to image metadata before promoting to the prod pool. No unsigned images in prod.
signer-bot: cosign: signature v3 created for image: gcr.io/redwood/prod/runtime:2026-03-21-rc2
infra-bot: canary deploy kicked off for pool runtime-canary (3 nodes). Monitoring targets: image pull success, app-start latency, kubelet auth errors, audit events.
oncall: alerts configured: >2% 5m error rate or imagePullBackOffs >1 triggers page. I'll monitor.
marta: if we see unexpected iam.policy.* or serviceAccount.keyCreate events during rollout, abort and rollback to previous image.
carlos: small IAM snippet (YAML) for reviewers to hand-check: 
```yaml
title: ImageSignerRole
permissions:
  - cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign
  - storage.objects.get
  - resourcemanager.projects.get
```
devsec: add runbook entry: incident steps for key compromise, immediate actions: revoke key, block signer SA, re-issue signer key, re-sign images, promote canary.
marta: thanks. I'll attach these notes to CHG-1894 and push infra-PR after review. :thumbsup:
